item.title: ODI News and Events
item.description:
Veteran Seeds for Growth

Join the Economic & Community Development Institute on Wednesday, November 5, 2025: for expert panels on small business financing, local resources, a workshop on using AI tools like ChatGPT to streamline your operations, and opportunities to connect with fellow veterans. Enjoy a complimentary lunch, explore the Veteran-Owned Marketplace, and enter drawings for a $500 grant and Women’s Business Center memberships.

RSVP TODAY

Level UP Summit 2025

Join a powerful sisterhood of professionals, leaders, dreamers, and doers for an immersive experience designed to elevate every part of your journey — personally and professionally. Through empowering breakout sessions, dynamic speakers, and transformative conversations, you’ll gain tools, insight, and unstoppable energy to fuel your next chapter.

At this summit, we rise together as women ready to:

  • Stand in our stillness and trust the deep wisdom we hold
  • Break beyond the banks of limitation and flow toward new opportunities
  • Be the drop that starts the ripple - creating impact in our lives, workplaces, and communities

Because water doesn’t ask for permission. It carves its own path. And so do we.

This is your moment to step into your next chapter. Whether you're climbing the ladder, building something new, or reclaiming your voice, the Level UP Summit meets you right where you are — and reminds you of just how far you can go.

LEARN MORE

Let's honor and celebrate our Vets!

 We are in the midst of Buy Veteran Week (November 1 - November 8), Veterans Day (November 11) and National Veterans Small Business Month!

NOW is the time to support a Veteran Owned Business! THINK VETERANS FIRST has supported Veterans, and Veteran Owned Businesses to bring awareness to causes that impact our veteran community, as well as bring awareness to who our Veteran Owned Businesses are and the services they provide. We have created a Veteran Business Directory as a one stop shop for veteran owned businesses. Click here to locate businesses or www.veteranownedbusiness.com.

item.title: ODI News & Events
item.description:
Columbus Metropolitan Library Business & Nonprofit Resource Center

Columbus Metropolitan Library Business & Nonprofit Resource Center is available to help answer your small business and nonprofit questions. Small businesses and nonprofits can meet with 13 community experts to get help with issues ranging from nonprofit fundraising to government procurement to business planning. Check out their website for specific dates and times to meet with their incredible experts! For questions, please email them at: business@columbuslibrary.org

Upcoming Events 

💪 Small Businesses, Strong Foundations | Sep. 4–25
This four-part program, held weekly on Thursdays, helps participants get their small business off to a great start. We'll cover business plans, legal steps, qualified advisors and more. Hosted by Courtnee Scott Hawkins, Director of Business Programs at Freedom Equity Inc.

💰 Find Funders with Foundation Directory | Sep. 23
This class will cover the basics of using the subscription-only Foundation Directory, available only at Main Library. Participants will learn to use the Foundation Directory to identify potential funders for their nonprofit organization and to assess the alignment of funders’ goals with their organization's programs and services.

LEARN MORE

Leadership Linden Academy - Applications Now Being Accepted For The 2026 Session!

The Leadership Linden Academy is a neighborhood-focused leadership enrichment program designed to engage, educate, and inspire both current and emerging leaders throughout Columbus to take a more active, informed role in our community. Applications are now open for Leadership Linden Academy 2026—a space where vision meets responsibility, and neighbors become leaders for the greater good. Open to all Franklin County residents.

LEARN MORE

State of Ohio APEX Accelerator Program and Business Resources

The APEX Accelerator program provides the education and training that all businesses need to become capable of participating in Department of Defense and other government contracts. APEX Accelerator programs provide a variety of services that include bid preparation assistance, one-on-one training, help with information resources, and trade events where Ohio firms can meet government buyers. These services are provided at no cost to Ohio businesses.

LEARN MORE

"Built on Skills" Career Training & Job Matching Expo

Join OhioMeansJobs of Columbus - Franklin County and the Workforce Development Network of Central Ohio Wednesday, September 24, 2025, for the "Built on Skills" Career Training Provider Expo to explore training and career opportunities in Advanced Manufacturing and Healthcare that can put you on the path to success. Visit with more than a dozen local training providers to learn about in-demand training and career opportunities, and hear how skills you already have can translate into job opportunities. On Thursday, September 25, 2025, attend the "Built on Skills" Job Matching Expo and be sure to register if you are seeking Job Matching services.

Join us for an exciting day of information and resources to enhance your supplier diversity and procurement opportunities! Attendees will have the opportunity to connect with governmental entities, industry leaders, entrepreneurs and professionals from various backgrounds.

This event will provide a variety of educational opportunities aimed at increasing supply chain sustainability and fostering inclusivity and collaboration in supplier diversity. It will also include information on a diverse range of funding opportunities and offer guidance on becoming certified.

Space is limited, so reserve your spot TODAY!

Visit our website to register and view the full agenda.. 

The Zone In Initiative is a multi-phase effort to comprehensively update the City’s Zoning Code and map for the first time in more than 70 years. Starting tomorrow, Council President Hardin and Council President Pro Tem Dorans, chair of the Zoning Committee, will hold a series of public hearings regarding the proposed new Zoning Code and map.

Hearing 1: Overview - Proposed Code and Map

Who:

Council President Shannon Hardin

Council President Pro Tem Rob Dorans

Representatives from Zone In, the Department of Development, and Building and Zoning Services

When and Where:

Tomorrow, May 7, 2024

5:30 pm – 7:00 pm

Douglas Recreation Center

1250 Windsor Ave.

The hearing will be live-streamed on Facebook and YouTube.

If you would like to provide written or public testimony, email Kevin McCain at kbmccain@columbus.gov by 3:00 pm tomorrow.

Written testimony should be emailed to Kevin McCain at kbmccain@columbus.gov - please include “written testimony” in the subject line of your email.

Members of the public can also sign up to speak in person at the hearing. Each speaker will be limited to remarks lasting no longer than three minutes.

Click Here to Learn More About Zone In and the Input Process!

Have You Heard the Benefits of Being City of Columbus MBE or WBE Certified?

Your business has direct access to exclusive City of Columbus contract opportunities for City of Columbus Certified MBE/WBEs!  In fact, we even have incentives and other ways to improve economic impact and increase diversity spend!  Find out about the City of Columbus Supplier Diversity Program and MBE/WBE Goal initiatives!

Construction Prequalification

Are You Prepared to Bid on City of Columbus Construction Work?

Construction prequalification is required for construction contracts that exceed $500,000.  If your firm performs construction related work, you must submit an application to get prequalified for General Contractors and Licensed Construction Trade Subcontractors in the following trades:

♦ Heating

♦ Ventilating & Air Conditioning

♦ Refrigeration

♦ Electrical

♦ Plumbing Hydronic

♦ Fire Protection/Firefighting Equipment

Website: https://www.columbus.gov/finance/financial-management-group/Office-of-Construction-Prequalification/

Email: prequalification@columbus.gov

Please allow 30 calendar days from the date of receipt
for application processing

You can boost your profile by adding branding, services, capabilities, references, past performance and more!  Adding commodity codes based on the products, services and capabilities you provide helps businesses better locate you!  Not sure where to find codes?  Use the NAICS search available here:  https://www.naics.com/search/

COMTO Columbus Scholarship Application - DEADLINE APRIL 12, 2024

COMTO Columbus provides a networking forum for minority professionals, which includes a broad and growing membership of individuals in all multi-modal agencies, large and small corporations, historically underutilized businesses, state departments of transportation, academic institutions and other non-profit organizations.  Our core values are reflected in our commitments to Advocacy, Diversity & Inclusion, Education & Scholarship, Integrity and Service.

If you are or know of a college student (traditional or adult) in need of a scholarship, apply for this opportunity for educational funding for historically underrepresented minority groups! Whether you’re planning a career in transportation or any STEAM related activities, this may be the scholarship opportunity for you!

ECDI is dedicated to assuring every entrepreneur – regardless of where they came from, where they live, their gender or their race – has access to funding and business mentoring services they need to build a business that thrives.

Construction Startup Cohort: Deadline to Apply is Friday, April 19th at 12 p.m.

Building a solid foundation in the construction industry is essential, but if you want your budding construction business to be successful, it’s crucial to understand the business side of things.

Led by industry experts, the Construction Startup Cohort bridges this gap by providing aspiring entrepreneurs with a comprehensive program that covers everything from business planning to strategic management in just 11 weeks! Curriculum Highlights include Business Planning, Market Research, Financial Statements & Operations Management Essentials. Visit and apply at https://www.ecdi.org/mcrc-cohort to give your business a solid foundation.

​ Important dates:

  • Application Deadline: Friday, April 19 at 12:00 p.m.
  • ​​Cohort Schedule: 5:30 - 7:00 p.m. on Thursdays starting April 25.

​Please note, courses will take place at ECDI's Columbus office at
1655 Old Leonard Ave, Columbus, OH 43219.
Learn More & Apply

Industry Insight Sessions: Professional Services Available for MCRC Clients

The Minority Contractor Resource Center (MCRC) strives to empowers MBEs for growth by providing comprehensive support, including business training, coaching, networking and procurement opportunities. Sessions offered cover various topics such as plain reading, estimation, project management, sales, business development, contractor prequalification, preconstruction & more!

If you are interested in access these services and learning from our expert volunteers, please complete the MCRC Professional Service Request Form.

MCRC Request Form

The event will be held from 4:30 PM to 6:30 p.m. and will feature a discussion of exciting projects like Intel Ohio One and The Merchant Building. It's a prime opportunity for diverse businesses to meet the Gilbane team, learn about upcoming ventures, and explore potential collaborations.

Register to attend at https://tinyurl.com/yz4ubthn.
